$comment: CONFIGURABLE. This file is the ceiling of what the agent roster may select from, never a target.
An allotment is keyed to the allotted agents rather than to the machine, may change when usage
is being conserved, and grants eligibility rather than requiring dispatch.
Idle allotment is a VALID state, not waste: nothing here creates work, and unused entries are fine.
HOW TO SHRINK USAGE (each edit takes effect at the next dispatch; it never kills a running lane):
1. Set "enabled": false            -> roster fully dormant; dispatch behaves as before it existed.
2. Delete an allowed[] entry, or a  -> that config is immediately ineligible for future advice.
model id from an entry's models[]
3. Set maxDispatchesPerDay on an    -> bounded trickle; the roster refuses to advise beyond the cap.
4. Delete this file                 -> treated as an EMPTY allotment (nothing allowed), loudly.
Growing is the same edits in reverse.
MODEL AUTHORITY: config/model-floor.json via src/lib/model-floor.js. Model ids
listed here are still refused unless they pass the model-floor check for their backend -- selection
is always allotment INTERSECT floor INTERSECT availability. An id listed here that is off the floor
is DROPPED at load with a logged warning, never honored. This block never restates the floor's lists.

allowed.$note: Fleet builder lanes may use the configured Vertex backend model allowed by config/model-floor.json.
Reviewer configurations are an eligibility ceiling only. models:null means this allotment does not pin a reviewer model; applicable model-floor rules still apply at use time.
Gemini review may use the configured subscription backend model allowed by config/model-floor.json.

budgets.$comment: Global conserve-usage lever. A number is a hard daily ceiling counted from roster events dated today; null = no cap.

parameters.$comment: Roster statistics knobs: minSamples = minimum agent-attributable outcomes before any promote/suspend decision (below it the config is honestly UNKNOWN); explorationEveryK = at most 1 of every K roster-advised dispatches may go to an under-sampled config; suspendDays = suspension expiry window.

$forbidden: No entry may identify an internal Codex tier alias. The loader refuses the whole file if one does.
